dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Sometimes, a throwaway comment in a conversation outside of the battle can be the decisive factor in who wins and who loses.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: So even in the downtime between battles, I intend to stay alert and ready.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Leave the intelligence gathering to me. You should rest.
